GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 3 lengths. not much room late # went well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced in restricted room over the concluding stages and could not be fully tested.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Eased to race Mid Field on inside (4L from lead) early . Stayed Mid Field on inside until improving on rail from 550m. Pushed to quicken behind leaders on inside (2L from lead) on home turn. Disappointed for rails run @ 350m & off heels @ 250m. Ground to line Two Wide in last 200m # didn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 900m was eased when tightened between runners. Passing the 350m was steadied when disappointed for a run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. hooked Wide turn 4 lengths. ran on strongly. # just did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out rounding the home turn and hampered by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (2L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace until & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Six Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. # Wide & weakened.

Best away. Pushed fwd & worked to race 4th Four Wide No Cover (1L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & outsprinted in last 150m. # Worked/stuck on OK
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide with cover 3 lengths. hooked 4 Wide turn 2 lengths. battled on well # covered ground
Jumped Ok 800m took sit 1-12l over-raced home turn 5th 2 Lengths Straightened Up 5th Kept Going Ok # honest effort
Jumped Ok Settled Down 0.3l 2nd i/d Leader home turn shared lead still there 200 co leader did better # solid on pace
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 3 lengths. Wide turn under pressure. weakened # Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 50m when weakening, was crowded for room between rnrs. When quest, rider stated she was instructed to ride her mount prominently from a wide barrier. She added that when her mount did not show sufficient speed, she was obliged to endure a tough run three-wide without cover, during which she felt the mare did not travel comfortably. She further reported that the mare may not have appreciated the firm track conditions. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to be slow to recover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well landed box seat 1 length off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off clear rails run, battled on strong to the line, no match leader/winner # box seat/leader won
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 lengths. 2nd turn 2 lengths. ran on strongly # too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out when under pressure in the home-straight.
